name: Isobel
title: Head of English Language and Literature at an Outstanding sixth-form college and AQA examiner
bio: Isobel is Head of English Language and Literature at an Ofsted-rated "Outstanding" sixth-form college.
She is an examiner for AQA, so she knows exactly how answers are marked against the levels and bands.
Isobel is a highly experienced, expert teacher who tutors A-level and GCSE English Language and English Literature.
offers: One-to-one online lessons for AS and A-level English Language and English Literature
Essay and analysis marking against AQA's levels and bands
GCSE English Language and English Literature
